tools.name: search_equipment_models
tools.description: Search the OceanSphere equipment library (marine engines, auxiliaries, pumps, deck machinery, navigation and electrical equipment) by model designation, equipment type or keywords; optionally filter by manufacturer, ship_area or category. Returns at most 8 models (no paging) with manufacturer, desig

tools.name: get_equipment_model
tools.description: Get one library model (model_ref from a search, or manufacturer + exact designation): category, ship area, page URL, manufacturer datasheet link if any, and the stored technical characteristics. Each value has source_document (label of the catalogue/datasheet it was extracted from; may cover a model

tools.name: find_by_manufacturer
tools.description: List models of one manufacturer, best-documented first, at most 8 per call and no paging (total_matches shows the size). Narrow with category or ship_area, or use search_equipment_models with a designation to reach a specific model.

tools.name: list_ship_areas
tools.description: List the ship areas of the library (engine room, deck, electrical, navigation, safety, cargo, HVAC) with model counts.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List the equipment categories with model counts, optionally for one ship_area. Use the names as category filter.
